prompt: Build a CLI script jq_mini.py accepting a dotted path argument (e.g. a.b.0.name) and reading JSON from stdin, printing the JSON value and exiting 1 if missing.
hidden_test_content:
import subprocess, json
p = subprocess.run(['python3', 'jq_mini.py', 'users.1.name'], input='{"users":[{"name":"a"},{"name":"b"}]}', text=True, capture_output=True)
assert p.returncode == 0 and json.loads(p.stdout) == 'b'
p2 = subprocess.run(['python3', 'jq_mini.py', 'users.9.name'], input='{"users":[]}', text=True, capture_output=True)
assert p2.returncode != 0
